title: Postgres + migrations + zero-cache + seed -> live reads
description: Biggest unlock: half the screens go live with no client changes. Postgres (wal_level=logical) + Drizzle migrations from §3 schema. Deploy zero-cache; set EXPO_PUBLIC_ZERO_SERVER (flips ZERO_ENABLED). Seed video/creator/cosmetic/league. Spec: BACKEND_PLAN.md §2,§4,§11

title: Auth service (Hono): anonymous + identity linking + JWT
description: Implement stubs behind apps/mobile/src/lib/auth/auth-context.tsx. POST /auth/anonymous -> {userID,token}. POST /auth/link/{email,apple,google} keep SAME userID, rotate JWT (sub=userID, short TTL+refresh, ZERO_AUTH_SECRET). auth_identity(provider,subject,user_id) unique(provider,subject). Spec: BACKEND_PLAN.md §6

title: Push endpoint: authoritative mutators (anti-cheat)
description: POST /push re-runs same-named mutators server-side authoritatively (PushProcessor + Postgres). Identity from JWT not args. Recompute economy; completeQuiz re-grades vs stored answer (core anti-cheat). Idempotency via mutationID; ownership checks; one tx/mutation. Start: earnXp, completeQuiz, saveWord, equipCosmetic. Spec: §5

title: Zero read permissions (row scoping)
description: zero-permissions: video/creator/league* public; app_user, vocabulary, achievement, cosmetic, notification, like, follow, progress row-scoped to auth.sub===user_id. Shared JWT verification key with auth service. Spec: §4

title: Native Apple / Google linking
description: Wire real native providers (buttons call empty stubs today). expo-apple-authentication -> identityToken to /auth/link/apple (Apple mandatory iOS). expo-auth-session/Google -> idToken to /auth/link/google. Needs a dev build; install via bunx expo install

title: Account merge on identity link
description: When a linked identity already maps to user A and current device is anon B, fold B into A in one Postgres tx. xp/gems sum EXCLUDING starter bonuses; streak/last_active max; vocab/cosmetic/achievement/follow/like/progress union; idempotent; tombstone merged_into=A. Spec: BACKEND_PLAN.md §6

title: Epic: Backend & auth rollout
description: Rollout of the backend + auth the anonymous-first (Duolingo-style) client already expects. Mobile flow (anon session -> onboarding gate -> feed -> link nudge) is complete on stubs; these light it up. Spec: apps/server/docs/BACKEND_PLAN.md

title: Periodic jobs: streak, leagues, push, analytics
description: Streak rollover (daily cron): reset xp_today, decrement/break streak, Sharik-misses-you nudges. Leagues (weekly cron): cohorts + promotion/relegation. Push: store Expo tokens, schedule nudges (APNs/FCM). Analytics ingestion -> Studio rollups. Spec: §8

title: Media pipeline (upload -> HLS -> posters)
description: video.hls_url/thumb are pointers only, never synced through Zero. Signed direct-upload URL (Studio) -> object storage. Transcode to HLS (Mux/ffmpeg) + poster. ASR captions + Studio quiz authoring -> subtitle/quiz JSON on video row. Spec: §7

title: Persist onboarding answers (schema migration)
description: Onboarding answers (CEFR level/goals/daily target) are device-local in lib/profile/local-profile.tsx; app_user has no columns. Migration: add learning_level text, goals text[], daily_target int. Extend completeOnboarding mutator + client. Spec: BACKEND_PLAN.md §6

title: Email OTP verification
description: Email linking is currently UNVERIFIED (email+password, no confirmation). Add POST /auth/email/start (send code) + /auth/email/verify (confirm, flip is_anonymous). Mobile: OTP entry screen after the email form in components/link-account-banner.tsx
